_comment: Facts about the estate that no API and no file can confirm, so a human has to state them.
Everything NOT in this file is derived at generation time — see build-infra-tracker.py.
The previous tracker inferred hosting from files on disk, and got two repos wrong in the
same way: a render.yaml in the tree made it say indiamasala deploys to Render (it does not,
that config was ported to GitHub Actions and deleted), and a main.tf made it say
surgerycare-web is on AWS (its backend is; the site is Cloudflare Pages). A file existing is
evidence that something was once true. It is not evidence of where traffic goes today.
So hosting, live URLs and budgets are DECLARED here and marked as such in the output. If one
is wrong, it is wrong because someone wrote it down wrong, not because a heuristic guessed.

indiamasala-web.purpose: Streaming availability + discovery for Indian cinema
indiamasala-web.extra: 22 scheduled GitHub Actions workflows run the Python ingest against Postgres

pawcial-web-and-app.purpose: Social app for dogs and dog owners

planesane-web-and-app.extra: Develop on staging, fast-forward to main. A free Render staging service tracks the staging branch — that is why the branch exists. Serving DB is Neon.

neurantra-web.purpose: Neurantra public site and product platform pages
neurantra-web.extra: Holds docs/SHIPPING.md, the canonical shipping runbook, and this generator

surgerycare-web.extra: The Pages project has NO Git integration and cannot be given one; the Action hands it a built dist/. Cloudflare's build log for it is permanently empty — read the Action's. backend/infra is separate AWS Terraform.

iyerspine-web.extra: The one exception to push-to-main: deploy.config.*.json plus a mix of shell and PowerShell. Was on web-main until 2026-08-31.

surgerycare-app.extra: Its clone lives inside iyerspine-web's working tree and is gitignored by it, so a folder scan of ~/dev walks past it. It is a separate repo.

mobile_apps.signing: PAWCIAL_UPLOAD_* in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties; injected at prebuild by plugins/withAndroidSigning.js
MYSURGEON_UPLOAD_* in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties; injected by plugins/withReleaseSigning.js. Prefix predates the rename.

services.limit: 3,000 min included on Team, $25 budget, Stop usage: Yes
services.note: indiamasala is ~94% of the load. The daily digest reports the month's pace and warns at 80% of the cap.
All five confirmed deploying on push. Root directory is the only per-project setting.

services.limit: 18 of 3,000 Workers build minutes used in Aug 2026
services.note: Deploy token is scoped to Cloudflare Pages: Edit only.

services.used_by: planesane-web-and-app (FastAPI api, production + a free staging service)
services.note: Staging is created by hand because Blueprints cannot create free instances.

services.used_by: iyerspine-web (ECS/RDS), surgerycare-web/backend (Terraform), indiamasala-web (SES for the digest)

services.note: indiamasala: Python writes, Next reads. im_web has select and nothing else.

services.limit: n/a — builds are local, Xcode Cloud is deliberately not used
services.note: Set aside to avoid a second metered build service.
Upload keystores are irreplaceable — lose one and that app can never be updated under the same listing.

attention.item: Upload keystores exist only on this Mac
attention.repos: chaturang-app, puzzlecub-app, and the 3 Expo apps' gradle.properties
attention.why: Gitignored by design and correctly so. But a lost keystore means that app can never be updated on Play under the same listing, and a fresh machine cannot build until both the keystore file and its properties are restored.
attention.action: Keep each keystore and its properties together in the password manager.

attention.item: OR photo licensing unconfirmed on a live page
attention.why: The README records the hero images as free-to-use pending confirmation. That confirmation never happened, and the site went live 25 August.
attention.action: Confirm licensing or swap the images.

attention.item: App screens on the live site are renderings
attention.why: Listed as a pre-launch item; launch happened without it. A visitor sees illustrations of a product on a page selling that product.
attention.action: Replace with real screenshots when the UI is final.

attention.why: A bridge branch between two histories that had no common ancestor. The old line it was syncing into was deleted on 2026-08-31; this branch was kept because it shares history with the live main.
attention.action: Decide whether anything on it is still wanted, then delete.

attention.item: The tracker's own generator is the thing to maintain
attention.why: The previous spreadsheet was hand-corrected and would have been overwritten by its own scanner. This one derives what it can and declares the rest, so a re-run is safe.
